title: P0 & Critical Security Response
objective: Menangani data loss, corruption, security critical, privacy leak, atau unrecoverable crash melalui emergency path.
limits: Register lokal dependency-free; register kosong tetap BLOCKED tanpa klaim incident. Tidak membuktikan incident nyata, security telemetry, user-data fault injection, native GUI, hosted CI, credential, signing public-trust, hardware, atau publikasi; gate eksternal DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
